content.comment_body: Here's a small tip for everyone: You already have access to a [product_name] operator interface in your pocket. Just activate the message blocks for the [product_name] operator device and use the web server to interact with a virtual version of it.

Hello, you can use the web server even with a [product_name] basic module without display and without an operator panel. The web server only requires that message texts are configured; an actual display is not necessary. In operation, if it's part of the [product_name] program, you can use the cursor buttons (on the basic module and operator panel), or the function keys from the operator device view. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members highlight that the integrated web server in [product_name] enables virtual interaction, eliminating the need for a physical operator device or display. With correct configuration of message texts, users can monitor and interact with their system using any web-enabled device, offering flexibility and avoiding extra hardware costs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to effectively monitor and control [product_name] systems through the web server, without needing to purchase an additional operator device. They look for straightforward setup to replicate operator panel functionality virtually.
